articles.title: Democrats make history after flipping North Carolina seat in US midterms | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 民主党在中期选举中赢得北卡罗来纳州席位，创造历史 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
The Democratic Party has won the largest majority in the US House of Representatives since 1992, after Democrat Chuck Hubbard unseated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina.
 
The race was called on Sunday, with Hubbard beating Foxx by 330 votes with 99% counted. It was one of the closest contests of the recent midterm elections, in which Democrats also secured the Senate.
 
The party has now won at least 258 House seats in the midterms compared to Republicans, who hold at least 173 seats, with four races still yet to be called.
 
Neither party had won as many House races since 1992, when Bill Clinton won the presidency and Democrats won a total of 258 seats.

articles.readingTextZh:
自1992年以来，民主党在美国众议院赢得了最大多数席位，此前民主党人查克·哈伯德（Chuck Hubbard）在北卡罗来纳州击败了共和党众议员弗吉尼亚·福克斯（Virginia Foxx）。

这场选举于周日宣布结果，在99%的选票统计完毕后，哈伯德以330票的优势击败了福克斯。

这是最近中期选举中最接近的角逐之一，民主党在该次选举中也赢得了参议院。

该党目前已在中期选举中赢得至少258个众议院席位，而共和党至少有173个席位，还有4个选区尚未宣布结果。

自1992年以来，两党均未在众议院选举中赢得如此多的席位。当年，比尔·克林顿当选总统，民主党共赢得258个席位。

articles.title: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 有史以来最长的联合国气候谈判以无果而终 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Countries have failed to reach a major new deal to tackle climate change after deep divisions over fossil fuels and money emerged at the UN COP31 talks in Turkey. 
 
Negotiations were due to finish on Friday but ran late into Sunday in search of common ground, becoming the longest UN climate conference in history. 
 
But the final deal proved unacceptable to the EU, Pacific island nations and others because it failed to directly mention fossil fuels, the main cause of global warming.
 
Meanwhile, many poorer countries objected to the absence of any clear financial commitments from richer nations to help them adapt to the impacts of rising temperatures.

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

Countries have failed to reach a major new deal to tackle climate change after deep divisions over fossil fuels and money emerged at the UN COP31 talks in Turkey.

Negotiations were due to finish on Friday but ran late into Sunday in search of common ground, becoming the longest UN climate conference in history.

But the final deal proved unacceptable to the EU, Pacific island nations and others because it failed to directly mention fossil fuels, the main cause of global warming.

articles.readingTextZh:
在土耳其举行的联合国COP31谈判中，各国在化石燃料和资金问题上出现深刻分歧，未能就应对气候变化达成一项重大的新协议。

谈判原定于周五结束，但为了寻求共识而延迟至周日，成为历史上历时最长的联合国气候大会。

但最终的协议被证明是欧盟、太平洋岛国和其他国家/地区所无法接受的，因为它没有直接提及全球变暖的主要原因——化石燃料。

与此同时，许多较贫穷的国家对富裕国家未作出任何明确的财政承诺以帮助它们适应气温上升的影响表示不满。

如需了解最新资讯，请下载BBC News应用程序或访问BBC.com/news

articles.title: How Amazon is shaping the next era of James Bond | The Global Story
articles.titleZh: 亚马逊如何塑造詹姆斯·邦德的下一个时代 | 全球故事
articles.summary:
Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond. The former Twilight star and Batman actor will take on one of cinema’s most scrutinised and iconic roles, after a five year search.

But the bigger story may be who’s making the decisions behind the scenes, Jeff Bezos says he was "'heavily involved" in the casting, but will he continue to influence the production?

Is Pattinson an inspired choice, or a safe one? And as Amazon takes control of the franchise, can 007 stay quintessentially British?

In this episode Tristan Redman hears from our producer Xandra Ellin, who explains Pattinson’s journey from teen heart-throb to Bond. We also revisit our earlier report on Amazon’s purchase of the franchise, with Wall Street Journal enterprise reporter Erich Schwartzel.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#007 #JamesBond #Cinema #BBCNews

articles.readingTextZh:
罗伯特·帕丁森将成为新一代詹姆斯·邦德。

经过五年的选角，这位曾出演《暮光之城》和《蝙蝠侠》的明星将接演电影史上最受瞩目、最具标志性的角色之一。

但更值得关注的可能是幕后决策者是谁。杰夫·贝索斯表示，他“深度参与”了选角工作，但他是否会继续对制作产生影响呢？

帕丁森是一个灵感之选，还是一个稳妥之选？

随着亚马逊接管该系列，007还能保持其典型的英伦风情吗？

在本期节目中，Tristan Redman听取了制片人Xandra Ellin的介绍，她讲述了帕丁森从万人迷偶像到邦德的演艺历程。

我们还将与《华尔街日报》企业记者Erich Schwartzel一起，回顾我们此前关于亚马逊收购该特许经营权的报道。

articles.title: America Is Losing the War Against Measles
articles.titleZh: 美国正在输掉与麻疹的战争
articles.summary:
In the wake of the US losing its measles elimination status, how can we understand why some parents have lost trust in our public health institutions and choose to delay or reject routine vaccinations for their children?

“We’ve asked mothers in particular to read all the labels, to assess every ingredient in every household product. We know that parents in general have fatigue for the number of decisions every day they’re being asked to make.”

Chasing Life with Dr. Sanjay Gupta is available on the CNN app and wherever you get your podcasts.
